text: Eve K: quick check on Alerting preview microcopy + accessibility. TL;DR: make action verbs explicit and surfacing suppression state more discoverable. Hiro: can you show the current copy? Eve K: current row: 'On-call Primary | #alerts-ops | quiet window' with icons. Marco: problem: 'quiet window' is easy to miss and 'On-call' is vague. Suggest 'Pages on-call: Primary' and 'Sends to channel: #alerts-ops'. Tess: +1. For suppression, use a pill 'Suppressed Muted for maintenance' not just a faded label. Tooltip for details. A11yBot: contrast note: muted pill text at 3.1:1. If it conveys behavior, must be >=4.5:1. Hiro: accessibility: screenreader should read full intent: e.g. 'Pages on-call Primary using PagerPolicy X. Currently suppressed: Muted for maintenance.' Use aria-live when the preview updates. Eve K: action items: update mock with action-first copy, stronger suppression pill, tooltip for long policy names (truncate with aria-describedby), and bump contrast. I'll upload new PNG once done. Marco: for long names, truncate and expose full name in an sr-only span or tooltip. code example: 'PagerPolicy: VeryLongName'. Tess: one more: avoid parentheses in visible copy; they read awkwardly in AT. Use em dash or separate label. Eve K: thanks all will iterate and follow up. :sparkles:
